summary: Iter54 full backend+frontend testing. Backend: 8/8 pytest passing (rider PWA manifest, rider PWA icons 192/512/512-maskable, 404 on bad size, rider-cms PATCH updates manifest theme_color + icon still valid PNG, reseed-women-fashion returns 100 with Chaussures+Sacs only, GET /api/public/products returns exactly 100 products with 100 unique images, categories subset of {Talons/Sandales/Mules/Ballerines/Baskets/Bottes/Mocassins/Espadrilles/Sacs à main/Pochettes/Mini sacs/Cabas/Sacs à dos}, no clothing categories, brands only Dina Soles/Dina Carry). Frontend: /console/livreur-app renders with data-testid=livreur-app and all 5 tabs (identite/onglets/annonces/aide/apercu); default tab is identite. Sidebar group order verified: SITE VITRINE → APP LIVREUR → PILOTAGE with 5 /console/livreur-app?tab= links. Onglets tab: 5 default rider-tab-row-0..4 present, rider-tab-add appends row-5, livreur-save fires toast 'App Livreur mise à jour · déployée en temps réel'. Annonces tab shows rider-ann-enabled. Aperçu tab shows rider-preview-iframe with src=/rider. Settings regression: /console/parametres has 12 tabs (Identité, Coordonnées, Ventes & caisse, Livraison, Paiements, Documents, Notifications, Intégrations, Équipe & horaires, Pointage, Sécurité, Données) with NO rider-app tab. Rider PWA manifest swap: on /rider link[rel=manifest].href=.../api/public/manifest-rider.webmanifest; after navigating to /login it reverts to .../api/public/manifest.webmanifest?v=... (storefront). /boutique landing + /boutique/catalog load without errors and render many product cards (>>50 shoe/bag products visible).
